info.title: RIVO API
info.description:
RIVO | ريفو — خرائط | داركم.

Smart navigation and the Iraqi real-estate marketplace in one API.

**Business rules enforced server-side:** 8–18 property photos, minimum 1080p reels, a 3,000 IQD listing fee, and payment state that only a verified gateway webhook can advance.

phone.description: Phone number. 07XXXXXXXXX and 9647XXXXXXXXX are accepted and normalised to E.164.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token to revoke. Omit to revoke the current device only.

allDevices.description: Revoke every session for this account.

avatarKey.description: R2 object key of an uploaded avatar.

marketingOptIn.description: Opt in or out of marketing messages.

telemetryOptIn.description: Consent to contribute anonymous speed samples that improve traffic estimates. Revoking stops collection immediately.

priceIqd.description: Price in whole Iraqi dinars. Sent as a string because values exceed 2^53 is not a risk but 2^31 is.

displayPrecision.description: APPROXIMATE publishes a jittered pin and hides the exact one. Gated by the approximate_location_option flag.

contactPhone.description: Overrides the account phone for this listing.

priceIqd.description: Price in whole Iraqi dinars. Sent as a string because values exceed 2^53 is not a risk but 2^31 is.

displayPrecision.description: APPROXIMATE publishes a jittered pin and hides the exact one. Gated by the approximate_location_option flag.

contactPhone.description: Overrides the account phone for this listing.

mediaIds.description: Media ids in the order they should appear.

coverMediaId.description: Media id to use as the listing cover.

contentLength.description: Exact byte length of the file.

checksumSha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, used to detect duplicate uploads.

propertyId.description: Draft listing the photos belong to.

use.description: Which version of this photo appears in the published listing.

force.description: Re-run enhancement even if a result already exists.

originBearing.description: Compass bearing of travel, so a reroute does not begin with a U-turn.

propertyId.description: Route to this listing. Uses the listing’s published coordinates.

actualSeconds.description: Actual travel time. Omit when the trip was abandoned.

headingDeg.description: Direction of travel the report applies to, in degrees from north.

confirmed.description: true = still there, false = not there.

lat.description: Reporter’s current position, used to weight the vote.

accuracyM.description: GPS accuracy in metres. Samples worse than 50 m are discarded.

sessionKey.description: Rotating pseudonymous session id generated by the client. Must NOT be a device id, advertising id or account id, and must be regenerated at least daily.

consent.description: Explicit confirmation the user consented. A batch with consent=false is discarded.

reference.description: Transfer or receipt number for the money actually received.

temporaryPassword.description: The new admin must change this on first sign-in.
